title: Fluctuations of the quadratic matching cost on the flat torus: dimensions five and higher
summary: We prove a central limit theorem for the quadratic matching cost between the uniform measure and its empirical counterpart on the flat torus in dimensions $d\ge5$. Let $μ$ be Haar probability measure on $\mathbb{T}^d$ and let $μ_n$ be the empirical measure of $n$ independent samples from $μ$.
